title: Report a missing book
summary: ASP.NET Web API: Report a missing book. Inspect the status too.
introduction: NotFound creates a 404 result. Open GET /missing. Read the example, then check the result.
learningObjectives: Report a missing book with ASP.NET Web API

blocks.text: Install the .NET SDK. Run dotnet new web -n SchoolApi and enter it. Replace Program.cs with one example. Run dotnet run --urls http://127.0.0.1:8000. These examples use controllers without a database.

blocks.title: Report a missing book

blocks.text: NotFound chooses status 404 and serialises the supplied error field.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: A missing item should not look like a successful response.
